missing_values: Empty CSV cells are missing/suppressed, not zero. Percentages are 0-100; ratios are fractions. No statistical independence is implied by rows.

fields.geography: Panel, England and Wales, or one of seven custom regional groups; panel and national rows overlap their regional rows. Do not sum both.
fields.quarter: Calendar transaction or decision quarter YYYY-Qn; charge quarter follows source methodology. Periods have different data vintages.
fields.property_type: HMLR code D detached, S semi-detached, T terraced, F flats/maisonettes; source categories retained.
fields.transactions_recorded: Category A Price Paid records present in source vintage, grouped by transaction quarter. Source deduplicates IDs and excludes deleted rows.
fields.share_pct: Property-type count / same geography-quarter recorded count * 100.

fields.transaction_month: Transaction month YYYY-MM, not month when record arrived in publication.
fields.transactions_recorded: Category A Price Paid records present in source vintage, grouped by transaction quarter. Source deduplicates IDs and excludes deleted rows.

fields.geography: Panel, England and Wales, or one of seven custom regional groups; panel and national rows overlap their regional rows. Do not sum both.
fields.quarter: Calendar transaction or decision quarter YYYY-Qn; charge quarter follows source methodology. Periods have different data vintages.
fields.transactions_recorded: Category A Price Paid records present in source vintage, grouped by transaction quarter. Source deduplicates IDs and excludes deleted rows.
fields.median_price_gbp: Source unadjusted median transaction price in GBP, withheld below 30 records. Not independently reconstructible from aggregates and not a constant-quality price index.
fields.new_build_share_pct: Source percentage; recent values withheld for lag concerns. Empty means missing/suppressed, never zero.
fields.source_lag_affected: Upstream heuristic flag using elapsed time and historical count comparisons. Not a measured completeness percentage.
fields.recorded_ratio_vs_previous_year: Current recorded count divided by same-quarter prior-year count; blank when no positive comparator. Not an estimate of eventual completeness.

fields.quarter: Calendar transaction or decision quarter YYYY-Qn; charge quarter follows source methodology. Periods have different data vintages.
fields.national_transactions: England and Wales category A recorded transactions.
fields.mapped_transactions: Sum of recorded transactions across seven regional groups.
fields.unmapped_transactions: National minus mapped transactions; retained unallocated.
